# iMosaicArt

> iMosaicArt is a premium US-based studio creating handcrafted natural stone and glass mosaic art — custom portraits, wall art, backsplashes, tabletops, and architectural installations for homes, businesses, and public spaces. Every piece is made to order and shipped free worldwide.

iMosaicArt fuses traditional Roman hand-cutting techniques with modern design precision. Each piece is cut and placed entirely by hand from natural marble and hand-cut glass, engineered for longevity indoors and outdoors. Clients collaborate directly with our artisans and in-house designers on color, texture, size, and layout — including fully bespoke commissions created from a photo, a painting, or an idea.
